command.name: Tactical Strike
verbatim: After each Basic Attack: Deal Tactical Damage to the target (Damage Rate: +50%). 30% chance to afflict Bleed on the target and 1 adjacent Enemy for 2 round(s).
At 6+ Stars: Deal Physical Damage to 1 Enemy adjacent to the target (excluding the original target) (Damage Rate: +30%). 18% chance to afflict Panic on the target and adjacent Enemy for 2 round(s).

vanguard.name: Champion's Brilliance
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Strength, Intelligence, and Instinct by +15. Reduce Damage Received by -8% of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Robust Insight
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase your Strength and Instinct by +20 until the end of combat.

habits.name: Battle Cunning
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce Strength and Intelligence by -6% (enhanced by Instinct) of 3 Enemies until the end of combat.

habits.name: Tactical Assault
habits.verbatim: Tactical Strike gains: after each Basic Attack, deal Physical Damage to 1 Enemy adjacent to the target (excluding the original target) (Damage Rate: +30%). 18% chance to afflict Panic on the target and an adjacent Enemy for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Dragon's Insight
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Reduce your Damage Received by -6% and increase your Instinct by +12% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Radiant Conqueror
habits.verbatim: Start of Round 1: Reduce your Damage Received by -50% for 1 round, then afflict Stun on yourself for 1 round. Start of Round 2: Reduce Physical Damage Dealt (excluding Basic Attacks) of the Enemy with the highest Strength and Fire Damage Dealt of the Enemy with the highest Intelligence by -10% for 5 round(s).
